content.summary: Five tasks. T1 scaffolds the Maven project (the pom needs a human sign-off on dependencies). T2 writes the acceptance suite plus a compile-only App stub and must be red. T3a (codes) and T3b (store) are independent and run in parallel. T4 wires the controller and must turn the suite green.

tasks.title: Project scaffold
tasks.description: pom.xml on spring-boot-starter-parent with starter-web and starter-test.

tasks.title: Acceptance tests (red) and App stub
tasks.description: src/test/java/demo/AppTest.java for AC-1..AC-6; src/main/java/demo/App.java with no endpoints.

tasks.title: Short-code generation
tasks.acceptance: Compiles; Codes tests green in isolation.

tasks.title: Storage port and in-memory adapter
tasks.acceptance: Compiles; store tests green in isolation.

content.sequencingRationale: Scaffold first (nothing compiles without it), tests second so the target is executable, the two pure classes in parallel because they share nothing, and the controller last so 'green' means the acceptance criteria are met.
